text:
### Mission  
Define product strategy, manage product lifecycle, and ensure product-market fit.
name: Chunk 11/102

raw_entities.name: Product Strategy Function
raw_entities.description: The organizational function responsible for defining product strategy, managing the product lifecycle, and ensuring product-market fit across FirstUK Bank's offerings.
context: Define product strategy, manage product lifecycle, and ensure product-market fit.

raw_entities.name: Product
raw_entities.description: A core banking concept representing financial offerings managed through the product lifecycle, subject to strategy definition and market fit validation.
context: Define product strategy, manage product lifecycle, and ensure product-market fit.

raw_entities.name: Product Strategy Definition
raw_entities.description: The governance requirement that product strategy must be formally defined as part of the product management function.
context: Define product strategy, manage product lifecycle, and ensure product-market fit.

raw_entities.name: Product Lifecycle Management
raw_entities.description: The operational rule requiring active management of products through their full lifecycle from conception to retirement.
context: Define product strategy, manage product lifecycle, and ensure product-market fit.

raw_entities.name: Product-Market Fit Validation
raw_entities.description: The requirement to ensure that products maintain alignment with market demand and customer needs throughout their lifecycle.
context: Define product strategy, manage product lifecycle, and ensure product-market fit.

properties.definition: A financial service or offering managed through a defined lifecycle with strategic positioning and market validation
